D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Scott Peters leads by 36.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 95,113 votes; a one point swing is about 1,293 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +29.8 and D +43.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.6M cash against $4K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
